title: Food texture close-up
slide_intent: Demonstrate how proximity can make a photograph feel sensory. A tight crop lets a viewer inspect the ingredients and surfaces themselves.
strategic_value: Instacart can invite appetite through recognizable details of a prepared dish without relying on an accompanying headline.
demonstration: A full-bleed close-up contains a fried egg, avocado, herbs and sliced onion. The yolk, scattered crumbs and overlapping ingredients fill the frame.
practical_value: Use a close crop when the food’s texture and color can carry the message at viewing size.

content_islands.name: Food photograph
content_islands.spec: Fill the entire canvas with the dish. Preserve the bright yolk beside the green avocado, with herb leaves and onion crossing the frame.

content_islands.name: Book identifiers
content_islands.spec: Keep the small running metadata near the top edge so the photograph remains the first read.
